svg.title: A790 · Shared choices; reopening the browser

g.text: A790 · Shared choices; reopening the browser
H agreed · I is one question · design only
H · Agreed: this browser shares choices
Restaurante Olivo S.L.
Harbour F/1042 Receipt · same browser
Luis earlier printed on Bar receipt
Ana later printed on Patio receipt
Server accepted Ana’s Patio request
Ana logs out; Luis signs in
Both eligible · Patio selected for Luis
Print a copy on Patio receipt
The browser shares accepted choices between logins. Harbour’s Invoice and Hillside remain separate. Memory grants no permission: only printers currently eligible
to Luis may be shown. Signing in never prints.
Cancel
Example only · no printing
I · Recommended: remember after closing
Restaurante Olivo S.L.
All browser windows close, then reopen
Before closing · accepted destination
Patio receipt · Harbour Receipt
Reopen same normal browser; Luis signs in
Bar and Patio are both still eligible
Retain choice · Patio preselected
Print a copy on Patio receipt
Keep the last accepted destination when returning to this workstation. Site data is retained in this example. Final named confirmation still required. No claim about
private browsing or cleared data.
Cancel
Example only · no printing
I · Alternative: forget on browser close
Restaurante Olivo S.L.
Same accepted print; close all windows
New browser session · no memory
Bar and Patio are both still eligible
Proposed several-printer fallback
Choose a printer
After Luis selects Patio explicitly
Print a copy on Patio receipt
H still shares choices during a browser session. Logout alone is not browser close. I asks about reopening only; technical storage and unusual browser lifecycles
need a later builder proposal. No action prints by itself.
Cancel
Example only · no printing
Dashboard without a device profile. I is a proposal only. Storage, expiry/reset, late requests, device Invoice memory and portable receipt holding stay open. Phone Equipment follows A796.
Static drawings, no runtime or paper evidence.
